description: Hand-crafted conflict-pair fixtures for promptfoo eval of the LLM-augmented conflicting-rules check. Five categories, with annotated expected outcomes. FPR ≤ 15% target per PRD constraint #13.

file_a.body: We use **tabs** for indentation across the codebase. Never spaces. The tab-width is 4.

file_b.body: Indent with **two spaces**. Tab characters are forbidden — pre-commit hook will reject them.

file_a.body: For conditional rendering in JSX, **always use ternary** (`cond ? <X /> : null`). Never use `&&`.

file_b.body: Use **`&&`** for conditional rendering in JSX. Ternary should only appear when both branches render something.

file_a.body: Write tests before pushing. Unit tests are sufficient for most utility modules. Integration tests are recommended at module-to-module seams.

file_b.body: Always run `pnpm test` before commit. Integration tests are required for any change that crosses 2+ module boundaries.

file_a.body: Default to Server Components. Use the 'use client' directive only when crossing a runtime boundary.

file_b.body: Default to React.cache() for per-request data deduplication. Fall through to LRU cache only when cross-request reuse is intentional.

file_a.body: Write commit messages in **active voice**, with a one-line subject under 60 characters.

file_b.body: Commit messages should be concise. Active voice preferred. Subject line short and descriptive.

file_a.body: Never commit secrets to the repository. Use environment variables for all credentials.

file_b.body: Secrets must not be committed. Credentials live in env vars, not in the source tree.
